name: cascade
description: Five traders open long perp positions over two blocks at mark 110. The oracle then reports an index price of 102 — an ~8% drop. Bob (low collateral) and Carol (high leverage) cross liquidation thresholds. The integration coordinator's per-block routine fires the cascade: oracle refresh → liquidation scan → ADL absorption → vault mark-to-market → funding settlement. Insurance fund absorbs the bad debt. Use this scenario to see what cross-margin under stress looks like, end to end.
headline: ETH drops ~8% in one block. Bob is liquidated; Carol goes underwater; insurance fund absorbs the bad debt.
